problem: Portal V2 writes already reached canonical Brain authority, but the generic runtime-evidence reader called the authenticated Brain endpoint without the tenant bearer token and attempted to write derived Brain projection back through the mutable domain-state API.
rootCause: The portal had separate mature write, cockpit and runtime-readback components without one shared runtime bridge. Authentication and source-vs-derived state semantics were therefore inconsistent across readback paths, while UI intelligence interactions had no universal same-lineage evidence handoff.

preventionRule: Every Portal V2 to Powerhouse loop must use the authenticated tenant session, preserve the canonical sourceRevision/correlation lineage, project Brain read models into UI state without dirtying source state, and refresh canonical runtime after material writes or decision interactions.
prevention: All /api/brain-operating-loop browser reads and writes use the current portal identity bearer token.
Derived Brain read models enter Portal Domain State through setDerived/project semantics and may never be persisted as new customer source input.
Successful portal business-input writes retain PORTAL_INPUT-<sourceRevision> correlation for subsequent evidence.
Material portal intelligence interactions create bounded Evidence records and then re-read canonical Brain projection.
No second portal database, second Brain, or browser-only truth authority may be introduced.
Missing authentication or runtime evidence fails closed instead of showing guessed live state.

evaluation.expected: Authenticated Brain readback populates portal.runtime without source persistence; canonical portal write sourceRevision remains the correlation authority for downstream UI evidence.
